parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id, then join compound_structures on that compound_records.molregno for canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key — this substrate-side join is mandatory (INNER JOIN). Join compound_records again on metabolite_record_id = compound_records.record_id for metabolite_compound_key — this metabolite-side join is optional (LEFT JOIN). Do not add sorting; preserve source row order. Return exactly: canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key.
